"Site can't be reached" means the box has an address but isn't answering, so the board isn't finishing its boot. Most likely fix: hold the reset button on the KD Box for about 10 seconds while powered, then leave it 5 minutes and try 10.0.0.70 again.

For photos and a fast hardware read, JD is on our Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, mention @nullhashrate.

And send me your 40T order number or order email, I'll check that now.
it kicked it off wi fi

That's expected, the reset wipes its network settings. The K. Box is happiest on a wired connection anyway, so leave the Ethernet cable from the box to your router plugged in and give it 5 minutes.

Then check your router's device list again and tell me what IP it shows now. If it comes back, open that IP in a browser.

Still happy to check your 40T too, just send the order number or the email you ordered with.
Im getting it up.
Take your time, I'm here. Tell me the IP it shows and whether the page loads.
it says wrong password. thats not possible. No what, thank you for helping

That's actually a good sign, the page is answering now. The reset put the login back to the factory password, so your own one won't work. The default is printed in the KD Box quick-start guide. If you don't have it, post on Discord and mention @nullhashrate, he'll give you the right one straight away.

You're welcome. One thing I'm curious about: what made you go for the 40T alongside the KD Box?
This is where it goes extra. Im told to enter numbers not visible?

Sounds like it's asking for a code off the unit itself, usually on the sticker underneath or on the box. Have a look there for a number separate from the serial.

If nothing matches, I'd rather not guess at it. JD knows that screen cold: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, mention @nullhashrate and send a photo of it.

Want me to put this in front of him by email too?

Is that the number off the unit, or your order number? If it's the number from the sticker, try it in that field and tell me what happens.

If it's the order, give me the email you ordered with and I'll pull the 40T up.

That's useful, I've added it to what JD has.

One thing that will tell him a lot: on the dashboard, what does the average hashrate read over that 2 to 3 hours, and does it show all chips working or some missing? If half the chips are dead you'd see roughly half the rated hashrate, which is a hardware fault, not a setting.
8.834   Its been running a while. We have several hours can you please fix it?
Used route to tech

I can't change settings on your box from here, only walk you through them.

At 8.834 against 22, that's roughly 40 percent, which usually means chips or a hash board not coming up, not a setting. Worth ruling out heat first: is it in a warm, closed space, and are the fans running hard? Give it good airflow and see if the number climbs.

If it stays near 9, that's a warranty case on Shop····, and I'll start that for you once JD confirms the fault.
next?

Next: on the dashboard, find the chip or board readout and tell me how many chips it reports working, plus the temperature it shows. That's the number that decides this.

If the chip count is short of what it should be, there's nothing to fix in software and it goes to warranty.

Leave it running overnight either way, and note the average in the morning. JD replies to your email tomorrow with the read on that code screen and the hashrate together.
